rationale: Bind the queued Cartier U.S. District Energy Platform label to the existing Cartier Energy Holding production company, preserve the single canonical company and its existing Vauban ownership period, add the reviewed Cartier aliases, and promote the direct Cartier Energy Holding identity-and-ownership release to the sole primary citation. No separate production company exists to retire, no owner identity is changed, and no exact ownership percentage or additional fund linkage is inferred.

evidence.purpose: Identity and ownership evidence linking the Cartier platform brand to Cartier Energy Holding, LLC and Vauban-managed investment funds.
supports: Cartier and Cartier Energy Holding refer to the same U.S. district-energy platform
Vauban-managed investment funds own the platform

evidence.purpose: Transaction signing and eight-system U.S. platform perimeter.
supports: Vauban agreed to acquire one U.S. district-energy platform
The reviewed platform perimeter contained eight systems

beforeImage.name: Cartier Energy Holding
beforeImage.description: Cartier Energy is a U.S. district energy platform that owns and operates systems providing steam, chilled water, hot water, and electricity. Its customers include universities, hospitals, municipalities, and commercial and industrial users that rely on essential thermal and energy infrastructure. The business is asset-heavy and infrastructure based, with revenues supported by utility-style service arrangements tied to on-site and campus energy systems. Public materials describe a portfolio of eight district energy systems located across New Jersey, Michigan, Delaware, Massachusetts, and Connecticut. Vauban Infrastructure Partners identifies Cartier as its first North American investment, and public disclosures indicate the platform is owned through Vauban-managed investment funds. The reviewed public materials do not disclose the exact ownership percentages of those funds within the current structure.
beforeImage.headquarters: New Jersey; Michigan; Delaware; Massachusetts; Connecticut

ownershipPeriods.vehicleName: Cartier Energy Fund SCS; Cartier Energy Fund II SCS

milestones.event: Vauban completed the acquisition of the Cartier district energy platform from prior owners.
Vauban identified Cartier as its first investment in North America.
Vauban announced the appointment of Adam Schiff as CEO of Cartier Energy Holding.
